name: agentic-vault
description: Shared Markdown memory, bounded session context, source-attributed recall and verified backups for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.43.0 adds opt-in tools for large vaults and shared repositories, and fixes defects those conditions exposed. Optional recall settings widen the total read budget and name priority paths, and every recall result reports omitted path samples, scope state and answer state; matches and ranking are unchanged. Read-only doctor reports cover note capacity and plugin scope; only --plugin-scope-host runs the claude program. Handoff folding moves old sections byte for byte into archive notes after a rebuild check and has no default threshold. vault_commit.py commits declared files by sha256 from a shared working tree but cannot stop another session's plain git commit. Lesson recurrence classes are read-only. The lesson cue hook is Claude Code only, not installed by default, advisory and unmeasured. Linked worktrees of the vault's repository count as copies in walks and deny zones. Checkout-only tools measure the preservation check on synthetic fixtures and compare selected tests across environment variations; synthetic rates are not evidence of real-world safety. Defect fixes change some default results: distinct state read failure codes, checkpoints of notes over 256 KiB, a fixed hook failure code, asynchronous hook failures in session evidence, preservation check fences, zero-fact notes and unit matching, and reported ledger rows with the wrong cell count. The compact constraints note renders item by item. A rule sentence on fact precedence kept prohibition answers on one small local model in a synthetic contrast, and no gain was confirmed. Default hook bindings and the configuration template are unchanged. The healthcheck, deny guard and vault-workflow rule stamps move to 0.43.0. No company-vault conversion or active installation update is made. Native discovery checks enabled skills and required installed resource bytes, not application compliance or semantic correctness. The seven certificate-bound checker files and committed LF harmless corpus are unchanged from v0.42.0; matching installed bound bytes alone do not require regeneration for this transition. For older changed-byte transitions, reset promoted warnings, align Claude Code/Codex/vault engine versions including rollback, regenerate with harmless replay, then re-promote. Hashes and reports bind bytes and declared observations, not identity, authority or truth. Final release results are recorded only after exact-source verification. For older transitions where checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again.
